genotype_to_drug_rule: Fits exact-method XGBoost 3.0.5 (400 rounds max, eta=0.1, max_depth=4, lambda=1.0, min_child_weight=1.0, colsample_bytree=0.5, patience=25 on outer fold 15% holdout, balanced fitting-side weights) on the outer training fold's 4,000 chi-square screened features; calls R at score >= 0.5.

i_handling.description: XGBoost outputs continuous probabilities thresholded at 0.5 (>=0.5 -> R, <0.5 -> S); any uncalled or failed fold genome is counted separately and never mapped to S.
